reason: I get hit with late-night anxiety, but I know my pattern—I always abandon self-care apps after four days. Paying a monthly subscription for something I'll stop opening just adds subscription guilt to my stress.
objection: I always abandon self-care apps after four days anyway, so paying a recurring fee feels like throwing money away.
would_change_my_mind: A pay-per-use venting pass or emergency late-night access instead of a monthly subscription that expects ongoing daily habit.
